meta.citation: UNEP-WCMC and IUCN (2026), Protected Planet: The World Database on Protected Areas (WDPA) and World Database on Other Effective Area-based Conservation Measures (WD-OECM) [Online], November 2026, Cambridge, UK: UNEP-WCMC and IUCN. Available at: www.protectedplanet.net.
meta.terms: Only fire statistics per protected area are published; no WDPA geometry or derived spatial data
meta.unit: n = VIIRS S-NPP-equivalent hotspots per month (2002-07..2025-12 harmonized archive; 2026 observed VIIRS, weight 1); frp = sum of harmonized Fire Radiative Power in MW per month (2026 observed); m = month index as in grid.json
meta.overlap_note: departments / regions of an area = those with at least one 0.1-degree grid-cell centre inside the area or at least one hotspot inside the area; hotspots count in every area that contains them, zones count the union of areas (each hotspot once); by_zone = the area's own series restricted to one department or region (hotspots inside the area AND inside that zone; only zones where it is not empty)
